title: Simple feature-first backend, frontend fixes and multi-provider API management
description: Consolidate ZhongWenHub into one local-first ASP.NET Core Web API project organized like DuAnTuyenDung with co-located feature controllers and services, fix frontend real-API flows, and add Admin Multi-Provider API Management with priority routing and failover.
phase: Simple Modular Monolith and Multi-Provider AI
acceptance_criteria: One ASP.NET Core production project and one test project replace the current three production projects and two test projects
Feature folders co-locate controllers, services, interfaces and DTOs following the DuAnTuyenDung organization style
Existing /api/v1 routes and role behavior remain compatible
Simple local Identity and JWT authentication remains functional without adding enterprise security infrastructure
Admin can create, edit, delete, enable, disable, test and prioritize Gemini, OpenAI and OpenAI-compatible providers
Provider API keys are encrypted locally, masked in responses and absent from logs
The AI router selects enabled providers by capability and priority and fails over on timeout, 408, 429 and 5xx
Frontend API failures surface typed error states and never become fake success data
Admin AI, results, dashboard video, skill, teacher and support production flows do not silently use mocks
All supported mutations persist and remain correct after reload
Fresh and upgrade SQL Server migration scenarios pass without rewriting applied migrations
Backend tests, frontend lint/tests/build and Playwright role flows pass
ZhongWenHub_Dev remains unchanged under strict zero-write policy
safety_constraints: Never write to ZhongWenHub_Dev or production databases
Never force-push or merge directly to main
Do not reset, stash, discard or overwrite unrelated local changes
Do not commit real JWT secrets or provider API keys
Do not return or log provider API keys
Do not rewrite applied EF migrations; use forward-only migrations
Do not add microservices, MediatR, CQRS, generic repositories or enterprise infrastructure
Stop after each phase and wait for Codex review
